printf '%b' 'import urllib.request, json
def get(u):
    try:
        r = urllib.request.urlopen(urllib.request.Request(u, headers={"User-Agent": "probe", "Accept": "application/vnd.github+json"}), timeout=30)
        return r.status, r.read().decode("utf-8", "replace"), r.geturl()
    except Exception as e:
        return getattr(e, "code", -1), str(e), u
s, body, final = get("https://github.com/timofurrer/maya/workflows/Continuous%20Integration%20and%20Deployment/badge.svg")
badge = "passing" if "passing" in body else ("failing" if "failing" in body else ("no status" if "no status" in body else "unknown"))
print("badge_http:", s, "badge_text:", badge, "final_url:", final)
s2, b2, f2 = get("https://api.github.com/repos/kennethreitz/maya/actions/runs?per_page=3")
runs = json.loads(b2).get("workflow_runs", []) if s2 == 200 else []
latest = [(r.get("name"), r.get("conclusion"), r.get("created_at")) for r in runs]
print("kennethreitz_maya_runs_http:", s2, "latest:", latest)
s3, b3, f3 = get("https://api.github.com/repos/timofurrer/maya")
print("timofurrer_maya_repo_http:", s3, "resolves_to:", json.loads(b3).get("full_name") if s3 == 200 else b3[:120])
ok = s == 200 and badge == "passing" and len(latest) > 0 and latest[0][1] == "success"
print("VERDICT_LINE: " + ("PASS badge shows passing and latest kennethreitz/maya workflow run succeeded" if ok else "FAIL badge=" + badge + " badge_http=" + str(s) + " latest_kennethreitz_run=" + str(latest[:1])))
' > /tmp/p.py && python3 /tmp/p.py || echo "VERDICT_LINE: FAIL probe crashed before reaching a verdict"
